description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer – .NET & Angular

 We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on Angular experience. This is a backend-heavy role focused on building scalable services and applications, with additional ownership of the UI layer.

 Must-Haves

 
 6+ years of software engineering experience 

 Strong hands-on expertise in C# and .NET 

 Experience with ASP.NET Core 

 Strong experience building REST APIs and microservices 

 Hands-on experience with Angular and TypeScript 

 Strong experience with relational databases, particularly Microsoft SQL Server and/or Oracle 

 Experience with automated testing and CI/CD 

 Solid understanding of system design, security, scalability, and performance 

 Strong communication, ownership, and problem-solving skills

 
 Nice-to-Haves

 
 Experience with Entity Framework Core 

 Experience with messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ 

 Experience with RxJS, Angular Material, or NgRx 

 Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases

 Familiarity with Redis or Elasticsearch 

 Experience with event-driven architectures 

 Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical initiatives

 
 Compensation, Benefits and Duration 

 Minimum Compensation: USD 34,000

 Maximum Compensation: USD 121,000

 Compensation is based on actual experience and qualifications of the candidate. The above is a reasonable and a good faith estimate for the role.

 Medical, vision, and dental benefits, 401k retirement plan, variable pay/incentives, paid time off, and paid holidays are available for full-time employees.

 This position is not available for independent contractors

 No applications will be considered if received more than 120 days after the date of this post.
